title: USP3 stabilizes NPM1 to sustain nucleosome assembly and promote bladder cancer chemoresistance
task: Characterize USP3-mediated stabilization of NPM1 as driver of nucleosome assembly and cisplatin chemoresistance in bladder cancer
key_results: USP3 upregulation correlated with poor bladder cancer prognosis; USP3 silencing impeded BCa cell proliferation and sensitized cells to cisplatin; USP3 removed K48-linked polyubiquitination of NPM1, stabilizing it to sustain nucleosome assembly (altered MNase digestion, elevated H3K56ac, exacerbated γ-H2AX signaling); USP3 knockdown was partially reversed by ectopic NPM1 expression
comments: The mechanistic link between nucleosome assembly buffering and DNA damage resistance is well-established, though the specificity of this pathway versus other USP3 substrates in chemoresistance contexts warrants investigation.
